text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. The first step is identifying risks, which means finding out what could go wrong in a project or business. Once risks are known, you can create mitigation strategies to reduce their impact. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are backup plans you can use if something fails. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks change over time. By checking regularly, you can spot new dangers early and update your plans. Good risk management does not remove all problems, but it helps you stay prepared and confident.
